summary: Former Kentucky state forestry tower site in Laurel County, dated to the 1930s and removed in the 1980s; now communications towers, with no forestry remains per the register.

facts.status_note: Register says no forestry tower remains are on the site; the site now holds communications towers and maintenance buildings
facts.agency: Kentucky Division of Forestry as cooperator; administered by London City and Laurel County Communications

access.note: Level inferred from current use as a communications site; the register states no access rule and does not describe public access

events.note: Registered June 9, 2017 on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register; nominated by Robert Wittenback

evidence.supports: Rocky Knob is in Laurel County, Kentucky

evidence.quote: This former site of a state forestry tower now has several communications towers with maintenance buildings.

evidence.supports: no forestry tower remains on the site
evidence.quote: There do not appear to be any of the forestry tower remains on-site.

evidence.supports: Kentucky Division of Forestry as cooperator
administered by London City and Laurel County Communications
evidence.quote: London City and Laurel County Communications

corrections.proposed: removed in the 1980s (decade only, no exact year)
corrections.why: The register gives only the decade ('Removed 1980s'); '1980' presents an approximate year as a single date.

notes_for_editor: Single source: the register page is the only source read, and web searches found nothing about this tower beyond it. Dates are decade-only in the register (1930s built, 1980s removed), so no built or removed event is recorded. Access level 'restricted' is inferred from current use as a communications site, not from a stated rule. The register shows a 2017 photo credited to Robert Wittenback, but no image URL was in the cached text, so no photo was added.
